description: This PHP source file defines the PurgeDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods for checking if an employee record is purgeable and extracting data based on employee number and other match criteria, interfacing with the database using query builders.

classes.name: PurgeDao
classes.description: A data access object class that provides methods for purging employee data in the HRM system.

methods.name: isEmployeePurgeable
methods.description: Checks if an employee identified by employee number can be purged based on termination and purge status.

methods.name: extractDataFromEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves data linked to an employee number from the specified table, supporting join operations.
